why.title: Why choose us?

faq.subtitle: We answer your technical questions about our air conditioning and aerothermal installations so you can make the best decision for your home.
faq.q1: How much does it cost to install air conditioning in Reus?
faq.a1: The price of an air conditioning installation in Reus depends on the type of unit, the required power and the complexity of the installation. At Clima HVAC Service we offer personalised quotes to ensure the best solution for your space and needs.
faq.q2: How often should air conditioning be serviced?
faq.a2: It is recommended to carry out maintenance at least once a year to ensure the proper functioning of the equipment. Maintenance helps improve energy efficiency, extend the life of the system and maintain good air quality.
faq.q3: In which areas do you offer air conditioning services?
faq.a3: We offer installation and maintenance of air conditioning systems in Reus, Tarragona and nearby towns such as Cambrils, Salou and Vila-seca.
faq.q4: Which brands do you work with?
faq.a4: We work with leading market brands such as Haier and Mitsubishi Electric, among others. We always install high energy-efficiency equipment.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.subtitle: At Clima HVAC Service we take pride in a job well done. Over 4,000 installations carried out in Reus, Tarragona and surrounding areas are the best reflection of our commitment to quality, speed and professional service.
testimonials.r1text: Excellent service! Clima HVAC Service installed my air conditioning on the same day and everything was perfect. Highly recommended!
testimonials.r2text: I had an emergency with my heating in the middle of winter and Clima HVAC Service fixed it quickly. Thank you for the excellent service!
testimonials.r3text: The preventive maintenance they offer is excellent. My HVAC system runs like new and I've noticed savings on my energy bill.
testimonials.r4text: Professional installers, they attended to me immediately and installed my air conditioning that same afternoon. Fast and clean. I recommend them.
testimonials.r5text: Impeccable service. They came to check my heat pump and within an hour it was running at 100%. Very professional and attentive.
testimonials.r6text: I hired them for a multi-split air conditioning installation and was very satisfied. Clean work, fair price and no surprises. Totally recommendable.

install.title: Air Conditioning Installation in Reus and Tarragona: Your Perfect Climate, Guaranteed
install.subtitle: Authorised RITE-certified installers to air-condition your home or business with maximum efficiency and cleanliness.
install.h1: Personalised residential and commercial air conditioning solutions
install.p1: Not all spaces are the same. That is why at Clima HVAC Service we carry out a prior study to determine which system best suits your structure and budget:
install.li1: The most aesthetic and silent solution for individual rooms.
install.li2: A single outdoor unit to air-condition several rooms, saving space and energy.
install.li3: Ideal for businesses or homes looking for invisible, uniform air distribution.
install.h2: Why trust Clima HVAC Service with your installation?
install.li4: We strictly comply with the Thermal Installations Regulations. Your safety and the legality of your installation are our priority.
install.li5: We install the latest generation Inverter equipment that reduces electricity consumption by up to 40% compared to older models.
install.li6: We work with industry leaders: Mitsubishi Electric, Haier, Fanworld and Seico, ensuring spare parts and durability.
install.li7: More than 4,000 installations in Reus, Tarragona and surrounding areas back our track record.
install.st1: Free technical visit to measure and quote.
install.st2: We choose the optimal location to avoid noise and direct draughts.
install.st3: Fast and clean installation in less than 24/48 hours.
install.st4: We verify there are no leaks in the refrigerant circuit.
install.st5: We show you how to use your equipment so you save from day one.
install.p4: Available in Reus, Tarragona and surroundings. Accept the quote in the morning and enjoy the perfect climate that same afternoon. Subject to technical availability and standard conditions.

aerot.title: Aerothermal Installation in Tarragona: Clean Energy for Your Home
aerot.subtitle: Replace your old boiler and save up to 70% on your bills with the most advanced thermal technology on the market.
aerot.h1: What is Aerothermal and how does it benefit you?
aerot.p1: Aerothermal is a technology that extracts free energy from outdoor air to heat and cool your home. It is the ultimate 3-in-1 system:
aerot.li3: Domestic Hot Water (DHW) all year round.
aerot.li4: By not depending on fossil fuels (gas or diesel), maintenance and running costs are minimal.
aerot.li5: No fuel tanks, no fumes and no risk of gas leaks.
aerot.li6: Drastically reduces CO₂ emissions from your home.
aerot.li7: Its operation is similar to a refrigerator; simple and durable.
aerot.li8: May be compatible with the MOVES Plan and other energy efficiency programmes.
aerot.h3: Experts in integration with Underfloor Heating and Radiators
aerot.p3a: We analyse whether your current system is compatible. We specialise in combining aerothermal with underfloor heating for unmatched thermal comfort, maintaining a constant temperature without noise or draughts.
aerot.p3b: We also integrate with low-temperature radiators and fan coils to maximise system performance in your home or business.
aerot.h4: How long does the installation take?
aerot.p4: A standard aerothermal installation is completed in 1 or 2 working days. Our technical team handles all the paperwork: legalisation, registration and RITE documentation included in the service.

manten.title: Air Conditioning Maintenance in Reus: Breathe Pure Air
manten.subtitle: Extend the life of your equipment, avoid costly breakdowns and ensure a bacteria and allergen-free environment.
manten.p1a: An air conditioning unit without maintenance not only consumes more electricity, but can become a source of respiratory infections. At Clima HVAC Service we take care of your health and your wallet.
manten.p1b: Annual maintenance can reduce energy consumption by up to 25% and triple the useful life of your equipment.
manten.h2: What does our professional technical inspection include?
manten.li1: Essential for removing dust, mites and bad smells that affect indoor air quality.
manten.li2: We apply certified bactericidal products that eliminate accumulated fungi, bacteria and allergens.
manten.li3: A low charge forces the compressor to work harder and use twice the energy. We detect it before it becomes a bigger problem.
manten.li4: We check connections to prevent short circuits or electronic board failures.
manten.li5: We prevent uncomfortable drips and damp patches on walls that damage the structure and cause mould.
manten.li6: We check the fan, compressor and fins to ensure correct heat exchange.
manten.p3: We offer annual maintenance contracts with scheduled inspections for individuals and businesses. These include priority service, discounts on inspections and peace of mind all year round. Request our rates with no obligation.
manten.p4: We manage complete installation maintenance for residents' associations, hotels, offices and industrial premises. We issue a technical report after each inspection and adapt to whatever schedule causes the least disruption.

repair.title: Personalised Air Conditioning Installation in Reus and Tarragona
repair.subtitle: A tailored quote with no obligation. We install the unit that best suits your space and needs.
repair.h1: An installation adapted to every space
repair.p1a: Every home or business has its own characteristics. That is why at Clima HVAC Service we carry out a free prior survey to determine the most efficient and cost-effective solution for your case.
repair.p1b: We work with the best brands on the market: Mitsubishi Electric, Haier, Daikin, Fujitsu and many more.
repair.h2: What does our personalised installation service include?
repair.li1: We assess your space and needs before presenting any quote.
repair.li2: We recommend the most efficient model based on the surface area, orientation and use of the space.
repair.li3: Our RITE-certified technicians carry out the installation in less than 24/48 hours.
repair.li4: We handle all technical documentation and regulatory registration.
repair.li5: We show you how to use the unit so you get the most out of its efficiency from day one.
repair.li6: All installations include a guarantee on labour and the installed equipment.
repair.h3: Clima HVAC Service promise: Fixed quote, no surprises
repair.p3: We provide a detailed quote before starting any work. We only proceed with your express authorisation. No small print, no hidden costs.
repair.p4: All installations include a written guarantee on labour. If any issue arising from the installation appears within the guarantee period, we return at no additional cost.
